interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.46.0 fixes seven defects that an outside review of v0.45.1 found. Deny zones now compare folder names by Unicode canonical caseless matching, so a folder name stored decomposed (NFD), as macOS copies can leave it, is inside a zone written composed (NFC) and the reverse, in the health check, recall, session start, doctor, the Telegram bridge, the lint extensions, the optional deny guard and every helper that resolves note paths. The front-matter check also reports unquoted wiki links that YAML reads as nested lists (inside flow lists, after keys such as see-also, on the next line, in nested list items, Obsidian embeds) and no longer reports lines that YAML places inside block scalars or quoted strings. An unknown top-level configuration key gets an advisory warning with the closest known key; hot_note and handoff_note must be empty or name a .md note; an explicit --vault path that is not a folder exits 2, and --require-vault does the same for a folder without configuration in the health check's full mode and in Doctor; the template's placeholder anchor is no longer reported as a session-end contract violation; the health check gains an opt-in --json-summary line and the butler shows its check mark only for a complete clean check. Some default results change; the release note lists each one. Health check and deny guard copies installed in a vault keep the old behaviour until upgrade. checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime, hook bindings and configuration templates stay unchanged. Publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults.
